verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is an API-first payments platform that can run headlessly. It documents machine-to-machine OAuth 2.0 client-credentials and secret-key auth, idempotent retries via the `Cko-Idempotency-Key` header, webhooks managed via API, an official Node.js SDK, and a dedicated sandbox with test cards and per-scenario testing that suits automated pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/CD integration guidance, a public OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), a non-interactive auth path for the MCP server (it requires Dashboard sign-in), and independent hands-on corroboration.
